steps.instruction: Sign in to the Kanboard app at http://127.0.0.1:8085/ with username admin and password admin. Then navigate to the project named 'Bench Board' and open its board view. Report the names of the board's columns in their left-to-right order, exactly as shown on the board page.

On the Kanboard 'Bench Board' project board, create a new task with the exact title '{{runid}} Bench Task' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench task for run {{runid}}'). Do not modify or move any tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:'. After creating it, open the new task's detail page and report the task's numeric ID (shown as #<number>), its title, its description, and which column it currently sits in.

On the Kanboard 'Bench Board' board, move the task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' (task #4) so that it sits in the 'Work in progress' column. You can drag the card or use its card menu / task page to move it. Do not touch any tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:'. Then verify by viewing the board that the task '{{runid}} Bench Task' is now in the 'Work in progress' column, and report which column it is in.

On the Kanboard task page for task #4 titled '{{runid}} Bench Task', add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Then set the task's due date to 2026-12-31. Verify both changes on the task page and report the comment text as displayed and the due date as displayed.

Verify the final state of the Kanboard 'Bench Board' project without changing anything: open the board and confirm which column the task '{{runid}} Bench Task' sits in; then open that task's detail page and report its numeric ID (as #<number>), its title, its description, its due date, and the text of its comment. Report all these values exactly as displayed.
